hero.title:
Welcome
to Aegealis
hero.subtitle: Studios and apartments in a palm garden, just across the road from Skala beach.

overview.title: A palm garden on the Skala seafront
overview.body:
Aegealis stands on the seafront road, directly opposite Skala beach. Around it is a garden with lawn, palms and shaded seating. The studios and one-bedroom apartments have sea, side-sea or garden views, and each one has a kitchenette and air conditioning.

You can use the pools of the hotels on either side, and the hotel next door serves a buffet breakfast (paid separately). The village centre is an 8–10 minute stroll along the sea. The Captain's cruise kiosk is right in front, and you board his boat just outside.

why.title: Location rated 9.9
why.body: Guests rate the location 9.9 out of 10: the beach is 20 m away and Skala's tavernas are a short walk along the sea.

why.title: Cleaned daily by Maria
why.body: Rooms are cleaned and towels changed every day, and guests mention Maria by name in review after review.

why.title: Two pools next door
why.body: The hotels on either side let you use their pools, so each day you can choose between the sea and a pool, both a few steps away.

why.title: 20% off scheduled cruises
why.body: Every scheduled Captain Vangelis cruise is 20% off for Aegealis guests, and you can book at the kiosk on your way to the beach.

aegealis.aroundIntro: From Aegealis the beach is 20 m away and the village centre about 500 m, an 8–10 minute walk.
goodToKnow: Our studios are compact and practical. For more space, choose a one-bedroom apartment or the family studio.
Wi-Fi is fine for messages and maps, but not for heavy streaming.

hero.title:
Welcome
to Theodora
hero.subtitle: Rooms, studios and apartments with a quiet garden, 100 m from the centre of Skala.

overview.title: The peach house above Skala's main street
overview.body:
Theodora is the peach house with red bougainvillea at the top of Skala's main street. The centre is 100 m away, yet the area is quiet. Behind the house is a shady garden with an orange tree, sunbeds and a view of vines, and a gate through to the neighbouring hotel's pool (subject to the hotel's season).

Choose from double rooms, studios, a triple room with terrace, and two two-bedroom apartments that each sleep up to five. Each has a kitchenette and air conditioning, and rooms are decorated with paintings made by the family. Village shops and tavernas are close by, and the beach is an easy walk downhill. Frosso and Vangelis usually welcome you themselves, with cold water already in the fridge.

why.title: Frosso and Vangelis
why.body: The family is there for you throughout your stay, with taxis, restaurant tips and boat trips.

why.title: Spotless, rated 9.5
why.body: Rooms are cleaned every day with fresh towels, even at weekends, and guests rate cleanliness 9.5.

why.title: Quiet, yet close
why.body: You're a minute from the supermarket, next door to a taverna and about 500 m from the beach.

why.title: Garden, pool, cruises
why.body: Sit in the shady garden or go through the gate to the neighbouring hotel's pool (subject to the hotel's season), and save 20% on the Captain's scheduled cruises.

theodora.aroundIntro: From Theodora the centre of Skala is about 100 m away, the supermarket a minute's walk and the beach about 500 m, a 5–10 minute walk.
goodToKnow: The walk back from the beach is gently uphill, about 10 minutes.
There is no private car park. Street parking is usually available nearby.
Free wired internet in the common areas only; there is no Wi-Fi in the rooms. If you need to work online, tell us before you book.
